stem_book: When a spring is stretched by a distance x, it exerts a force, given by F = (−5x − 16x³) N. The work done, when the spring is stretched from 0.1 m to 0.2 m is: (a) 8.1 × 10^(−2) J (b) 12.2 × 10^(−2) J (c) 8.1 × 10^(−1) J (d) 12.2 × 10^(−1) J
reason: work by the stretching agent (spring's own work is −8.1 × 10^(−2) J)
